from.place: canonical absolute exterior-product map and its terminal-topos comparison

title: The absolute ordinary Kunneth arrow
statement: For a monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficient category A and morphisms p: Z → X, q: Z → Y, fix a strong monoidal structure on the constant-sheaf functor on Z and assume that it preserves flat objects. Let F_T be the derived constant-sheaf functor and G_T its right adjoint RΓ(T,-), as in [def-kun-constant-projection-morphism]. Let α_p: F_Z ≅ F_X ⋙ Lp* be the derived inverse of the canonical constant-pullback isomorphism. For K in D(X,A), M in D(Y,A), define a_p = α_p(G_X K) followed by Lp*(ε_X(K)), and a_q similarly. The absolute ordinary Kunneth arrow G_X K ⊗ G_Y M → G_Z(Lp*K ⊗ Lq*M) is the adjunct under F_Z ⊣ G_Z of δ_Z followed by a_p ⊗ a_q. Here δ_Z is the derived tensor comparison for the specified monoidal constant-sheaf functor, using [def-kun-derived-tensor]. All comparisons and tensors are the ordinary uncompleted canonical ones of [def-kun-kunneth-map].

def ordinaryGlobalKunnethMap {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : Z ⟶ X) (q : Z ⟶ Y)
    [(constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology A).Monoidal]
    [(constantSheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology A).PreservesFlat]
    (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology A))
    (M : DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology A)) :
    (rightDerivedGlobalSections A X).obj K ⊗
        (rightDerivedGlobalSections A Y).obj M ⟶
      (rightDerivedGlobalSections A Z).obj
        (((curriedTensor (DerivedCategory (Sheaf Z.smallEtaleTopology A))).obj
          ((L((p)^*[A])).obj K)).obj
            ((L((q)^*[A])).obj M))
